card.name: "That" after lowest dose or shortest duration
card.fires_on: The word "that" right after "the lowest dosage", "lowest dose" or "shortest duration" in dosing instructions. Also "the" after "guided by the severity of infection and".

modes.label: Lowest dose that
modes.description: "that" opens a clause after lowest dose or shortest duration, saying what the amount should achieve.
modes.example: titrate each patient's dose to the lowest dosage<< that>> effectively controls his/her symptoms

modes.label: Therapy duration guidance
modes.description: "the" after "severity of infection and" in advice on how long to treat.
modes.example: The duration of therapy should be guided by the severity and site of infection and<< the>> patient’s clinical and bacteriological progress.

card.plain: It fires on the small word that follows "lowest dose" or "shortest duration" and introduces what the dose should accomplish.
